name: PicoLM
summary: C11 LLM inference engine that runs a 1-billion parameter model on $10 boards with 256MB RAM.
description: A from-scratch LLM inference engine in about 2,500 lines of C11 with zero dependencies. It runs TinyLlama 1.1B and other LLaMA-architecture GGUF models on Raspberry Pi, LicheeRV and x86-64 machines in ~45 MB of RAM, and it is the offline brain of the PicoClaw agent.
contains: ~2,500 lines of C11; ~80 KB binary; only libc, libm, libpthread
runs TinyLlama 1.1B Q4KM (638 MB) in ~45 MB RAM
~13 tok/s on x86-64, ~8 tok/s on Pi 4, ~1 tok/s on a $10 LicheeRV Nano
mmap layer streaming, FP16 KV cache, flash attention, NEON/SSE2 SIMD
grammar-constrained JSON mode for tool calling
any LLaMA-architecture GGUF model; Q2K, Q3K, Q4K, Q5K, Q6K, Q80, F16, F32
one-line install script for Raspberry Pi / Linux
